comment: Dev characters (devMode in meta.json): they can learn every move the game can play, to test moves. Stats on the scale of the starters; model: the Pokémon whose sprites and portrait they use; growthOf: the Pokémon whose level-up gains they get. No type (no STAB), standard movement (terrain applies). Never recruited, saved as unlocked or met as enemies. heldItem: the held item it starts a run with (held_items.json key). abilities: the ability it starts with (AbilityLibrary id), until one is picked in the menu (R2 / Tab) or in a run (J).
